desc:
🎨🔍 Paint Or Seek 🔍🎨

Can you hide in plain sight? 👀

🖌️ Paint yourself to match the environment and become almost invisible!
🌈 Blend into walls, floors, and objects to avoid being found.
🏃 Survive as a Hider while the Seekers search every corner of the map!
💀 Got caught? Don't worry! You'll join the Seekers and help hunt down the remaining players!

✨ Features:
🎨 Fun painting and camouflage mechanics
🗺️ Unique maps to hide in
👥 Play with friends and family
🏆 Earn wins and climb the leaderboard
🔄 Fast-paced rounds with lots of surprises

⚠️ Painting Rules
Painting is meant to help you "blend in with the environment". Please don't use it to create inappropriate or offensive drawings. Misusing this feature may result in warnings or bans.
